Verify committed import map:
npm run importmap
git diff --exit-code -- vendor-importmap.js
Lint shell:
mapfile -t FILES < <(git ls-files -- '*.sh' '.githooks/*')
if [ "${#FILES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::no shell files selected"
  exit 1
fi
shellcheck "${FILES[@]}"
Lint workflows:
mapfile -t FILES < <(git ls-files -- '.github/workflows/*.yml' '.github/workflows/*.yaml')
if [ "${#FILES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::no workflow files selected"
  exit 1
fi
actionlint -verbose -oneline "${FILES[@]}" 2> /tmp/actionlint-verbose.txt
if grep -q 'Rule "shellcheck" was disabled' /tmp/actionlint-verbose.txt; then
  echo "::error::actionlint ran without shellcheck — the run: bodies went unchecked"
  exit 1
fi
echo "actionlint clean: ${#FILES[@]} workflows linted."
